actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train used to index chunks by token: for each merge it called merge() on every chunk containing both tokens anywhere, even when they were not next to each other. It now indexes chunks by pair, which can be stale but always covers every chunk holding the pair. Each merge only visits chunks listed for that pair, and the merged pair's entry is dropped because a merged pair can never form again. Tie-breaking now scans only the chunks listed for the candidate pairs, in chunk order, using filter in C. The pair picked is the same as before, since the result does not depend on stats dict order and the chunk/position tie order is kept. Outputs are identical in the equivalence harness; train_ir ratio is 0.966.
